subject: general
question: Which one of the following Indian state is the leading producer of soybean in year 2019-20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the year 2019-20,** Madhya Pradesh** was the leading producer of soybeans in India.
 
• The state has favorable climatic conditions and suitable soil for soybean cultivation, making it the largest producer in the country.
 
• As of **2024**, Madhya Pradesh continues to be the leading producer of soybeans in India. In the 2023-24 crop year, India's soybean production is projected to reach approximately 12.1 million metric tonnes, with Madhya Pradesh accounting for a significant portion of this output.
